description: This file defines the IMediaRecorder interface and its implementation classes, including method declarations for media recording operations such as setting sources, formats, encoders, and controlling recording states. It also includes transaction handling for IPC communication within the Android media framework.

classes.name: BpMediaRecorder
classes.description: Proxy class for IMediaRecorder interface, providing IPC method implementations.

methods.name: setCamera
methods.description: Sets the camera and proxy for media recording.

methods.name: querySurfaceMediaSource
methods.description: Queries for the surface media source associated with the recorder.

methods.name: setPreviewSurface
methods.description: Sets the surface for preview display.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the media recorder.

methods.name: setVideoSource
methods.description: Sets the video source.

methods.name: setAudioSource
methods.description: Sets the audio source.

methods.name: setOutputFormat
methods.description: Sets the output format.

methods.name: setVideoEncoder
methods.description: Sets the video encoder.

methods.name: setAudioEncoder
methods.description: Sets the audio encoder.

methods.name: setOutputFile
methods.description: Sets the output file by path.

methods.name: setOutputFile (fd, offset, length)
methods.description: Sets the output file using a file descriptor, offset, and length.

methods.name: setVideoSize
methods.description: Sets the video resolution.

methods.name: setVideoFrameRate
methods.description: Sets the video frame rate.

methods.name: setParameters
methods.description: Sets parameters for the media recorder.

methods.name: setListener
methods.description: Sets the media recorder event listener.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the media recorder for recording.

methods.name: getMaxAmplitude
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum amplitude since last call.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts recording.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops recording.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the recorder to initial state.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the recorder.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the recorder.
